dialogue.content: 本日はロールプレイよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for participating in the role-play today. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。時間になったら始めさせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Okay!

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 相談にいらして下さりありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. What would you like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 恋愛についてです
dialogue.English: It's about romance.

dialogue.content: 恋愛についてですね。どういったことか、詳しくお話しくださいますか？
dialogue.English: Romance, I see. Could you tell me more about what's been happening?

dialogue.content: 彼氏が浮気ばかりするんです浮気というか、二股？もっといるかも
dialogue.English: My boyfriend keeps cheating on me. Well, not just cheating... two-timing? Maybe even more.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、納得がいかないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very frustrating and hard to accept.

dialogue.content: 最初に発覚した時点で、遊びたいなら他に行って、って言ったのに「ちゃんとつきあいたい」って言ったから信じてやり直したのに、それからもちょこちょこあって何度も話しあってるんですけど全然変わらなくて
dialogue.English: The first time I found out, I told him that if he just wanted to play around, he should go somewhere else. But he said he wanted a serious relationship with me, so I believed him and we started over. But since then, it's happened again and again, and we've talked about it so many times, but he just doesn't change.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。彼を信じようとしても、裏切られるようなことが続くとやるせない気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be heartbreaking to try to trust him, only to be betrayed repeatedly.

dialogue.content: ほんとに辛くて周りからは別れた方がいいって言われるんですけど一緒にいるとすごく気が合うっていうか、自然でいられて楽しいし、仕事の話もできるし、すごく合うんです
dialogue.English: It's just so painful. Everyone around me tells me I should break up with him, but when we're together, we get along so well. I can be myself, it's fun, we can talk about work... we're just a really good match.

dialogue.content: どうしたら、浮気をやめてくれるかなと思って
dialogue.English: I keep wondering what I can do to get him to stop cheating.

dialogue.content: そう思うんですね。
dialogue.English: I see that's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: はい、どうしたら伝わるかと思って
dialogue.English: Yes—I'm wondering how I can get through to him.

dialogue.content: すごい寂しい人だと思うんです家庭環境が複雑だったりしてだからわたしが、本当の愛を教えてあげたいんです
dialogue.English: I think he's a very lonely person. He had a complicated family life, so I want to be the one to teach him what true love is.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、もう辛くなってきて
dialogue.English: But it’s starting to become too painful for me.

dialogue.content: ええ、あなたは彼のことをこんなに思っているのに、彼は自分を裏切るような行為を繰り返すのでは・・・。おつらいお気持ち、伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: Yes, you care so much for him, yet he repeatedly does things that betray you... I can hear how much pain you're in.

dialogue.content: でも、別れられないんです別れた方がいいって言われるんですけど、本当はいい人だし、
dialogue.English: But I can't break up with him. People tell me I should, but he's a good person deep down, and...

dialogue.content: 浮気は治らないものですか？
dialogue.English: Is cheating something that can't be cured?

dialogue.content: 彼に自分だけを見て欲しいと思うのも、自然な気持ちですよね。
dialogue.English: It's only natural to want him to have eyes only for you.

dialogue.content: 浮気については個々の事情などもありますから、一概には言えませんが、一緒にどうしたらいいか、考えましょうね。
dialogue.English: When it comes to cheating, individual circumstances vary, so it’s hard to make a blanket statement. Let’s think together about what we can do.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？別れた方がいいんでしょうか
dialogue.English: What should I do? Should I just break up with him?

dialogue.content: あなたのことをもっと理解したいので、少し質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to understand you and your situation better. May I ask a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼とはどういった経緯でお付き合いするようになったのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you and he start dating?

dialogue.content: 職場の近くの飲食店の店長で、時々ランチに行ったりして顔見知りになって、みんなで夜飲みに行ったりするようになって、彼から付き合おうと言われました
dialogue.English: He's the manager of a restaurant near my workplace. I would sometimes go there for lunch and we became acquaintances. Then we started going out for drinks with a group at night, and he was the one who asked me to be his girlfriend.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。彼の方からあなたを誘ってきたんですね。ちなみに、あなたは今おいくつですか。
dialogue.English: I see. So he was the one who approached you. By the way, how old are you, if you don't mind me asking?

dialogue.content: 27歳です
お答えありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing.

dialogue.content: みんなで飲みに行ったりする中で親しくなったということなんですね。
dialogue.English: So you grew closer through those group outings for drinks.

dialogue.content: そうですね最初からかっこいいなとは思ってて、わたしの友達もみんなファンだったので嬉しかったです
dialogue.English: That's right. I thought he was handsome from the beginning, and all my friends were fans of his, so I was really happy.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。素敵な方なんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. He sounds like a wonderful person.

dialogue.content: 彼のこと、他にはどんなところが好きですか？
dialogue.English: What else do you like about him?

dialogue.content: 大人で、仕事の相談に対しても的確に助言してくれるのでそういうところは尊敬しています
dialogue.English: He's mature and gives me very precise advice when I talk to him about work. I respect that about him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ちなみに彼はおいくつなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. And how old is he, by the way?

dialogue.content: １つ上です。28歳です。
dialogue.English: He’s one year older—he’s 28.

dialogue.content: 中身がわたしより大人だなーって感じます。
dialogue.English: I feel like he's more mature than me on the inside.

dialogue.content: 浮気以外は
dialogue.English: Except for the cheating.

dialogue.content: なるほど、精神的に頼りになる面もあるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so there are aspects of him that you can rely on emotionally.

dialogue.content: はいわたしも一緒にいて、すごく自然でいられて、、浮気以外は本当にいい関係だと思うんですけど
dialogue.English: Yes. And I can be so natural around him... I really think we have a good relationship, except for the cheating.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。ちなみに、付き合ってどれくらいですか？よろしければその間にどれくらい浮気があったのか、そいった辺りはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. By the way, how long have you been dating? If you're comfortable sharing, how many times has he cheated during that time? What has that been like?

dialogue.content: そういった辺り、でした。すみません。
dialogue.English: 'What has that been like,' I meant to say. My apologies.

dialogue.content: 1年半くらいですはっきり発覚したのは、4回くらい、、、というか始めから、元カノと同棲してるのを内緒にしててそれが発覚して、もう、別れてるから、部屋を見つけて出るまで待ってって言われてでもそのすぐあとに、他にも19歳の系列店のバイトの子に手を出してるのがわかって
dialogue.English: About a year and a half. There have been around four clear incidents... Actually, from the start, he was hiding that he was still living with his ex. When I found out, he said they’d already broken up and asked me to wait until he found a new place and moved out. But soon after that, I learned he had also gotten involved with a 19-year-old part-timer at one of the chain’s other locations.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、、。その度に振り回されて、気持ち落ち込みますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be so emotionally draining to be jerked around like that each time.

dialogue.content: その子と別れたあとも少ししたらまた別の子がいて、、
dialogue.English: And even after he broke up with that girl, it wasn't long before there was another one...

dialogue.content: ちなみに、元カノとの同棲はその後どうなったんですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what happened with him living with his ex-girlfriend?

dialogue.content: そっかー。（行違いましたすみません。）
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. (Sorry, our messages crossed.)

dialogue.content: 結構すぐに、部屋を借りて一人暮らしをしてくれたので本気なんだとおもったんですけど
dialogue.English: He rented an apartment and started living alone pretty quickly, so I thought he was serious about me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 病気ですよねなんかもう本当意味わからなくてわたしとはすごく仲良くて楽しく過ごしてるのに、数日会わない日は誰か別の子と会ってて
dialogue.English: It's like a sickness, isn't it? I just don't get it. We get along so well and have a great time together, but on the days we don't see each other for a few days, he's meeting up with someone else.

dialogue.content: でも、すごく楽しくて話も気も合うし、浮気以外別れる理由はないんです
dialogue.English: But it's so much fun, we talk about everything, and we just click. Besides the cheating, there's no reason to break up.

dialogue.content: そう思っておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい、彼もわたしが言わなければ別れたいとは言わないし
dialogue.English: Yes, and he never says he wants to break up unless I bring it up.

dialogue.content: そうかあ。一緒にいて楽しい分、浮気も信じられないような気持ちにもなってしまうのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps because you have so much fun together, it makes the cheating feel even more unbelievable.

dialogue.content: たしかにそうです。
dialogue.English: That’s true.

dialogue.content: 浮気がわかった時には、ケンカもされるかと思うのですが、その時のあなたは別れようと思うこともありますか？
dialogue.English: I imagine you fight when you find out he's cheated. At those times, do you ever think about breaking up?

dialogue.content: あります。いつも思うんですけど、でも、浮気以外は不満はないので、、相手の子にそれほど夢中って感じもしないし、じゃあ別れる意味あるのかなとか思っちゃって
dialogue.English: I do. I always think that, but aside from the cheating I have no complaints, and he doesn’t seem that obsessed with the other girls, so I end up wondering if there’s any point in breaking up.

dialogue.content: 別れたい時は、どんな感情があるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you do feel like breaking up, what kind of emotions do you have?

dialogue.content: 自分が一番好かれているなら、他の女の子たちはそんなに問題じゃないという風に考え直すのですね。
dialogue.English: So you rethink it, feeling that as long as you're the one he loves most, the other girls aren't such a big problem.

dialogue.content: なんで！？って思います夜中に大喧嘩したりもして
dialogue.English: I just think, "Why?!" We've had huge fights in the middle of the night.

dialogue.content: （すみません前後してしまって）そうですよね。ケンカの最中は、許せない、とか信じられない、とかいろんな感情もありますよね。
dialogue.English: (Sorry, our messages got out of order.) Right. During the fight, you must feel all sorts of things, like "I can't forgive him," or "I can't believe it."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、彼のことが大好きで、尊敬する面もあり、浮気されることだけが、不満なんですよね。
dialogue.English: You love him very much, you have aspects you respect about him, and the only thing you're unhappy with is the cheating, correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周りの人たちは別れた方がいいと言うけれど、あなたとしては浮気さえ何とかなればいいのに、とお考えです。
dialogue.English: People around you say you should break up, but you think that if only the cheating could be resolved, everything would be fine.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼は、元カノとの同棲も解消したし、いつも他の子のことは本気じゃない、あなたとしっかり付き合いたいと、浮気の度に言う・・・。
dialogue.English: He ended the cohabitation with his ex, and every time he cheats, he says he's not serious about the other girls and that he wants to be in a serious relationship with you...

dialogue.content: 毎回、わたしとやり直したいとは言わないですわたしが嫌なら別れよう、みたいな
dialogue.English: He doesn't say he wants to start over with me every time. It's more like, "If you don't like it, we can break up."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そういわれて、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel when he says that?

dialogue.content: そんなに言うなら別れてもいいよみたいな感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like he's saying, "If you're going to make a big deal about it, I'm fine with breaking up."

dialogue.content: そう言われると本当の愛を教えてあげたいって思います
dialogue.English: When he says that, it makes me want to teach him what true love is.

dialogue.content: 人を信じられないのかな、って寂しいのかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder if he just can’t trust people—if he’s lonely.

dialogue.content: そう思うんですね。
dialogue.English: That’s what you think.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結局別れられないんです
dialogue.English: In the end, I just can't break up with him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。自分で決めているということもあり、一緒にいることを選んでいるのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So in making your own decision, you’re choosing to stay with him.

dialogue.content: でももうやめた方がいいんでしょうか。他の人を探そうと思ったこともあるんですけど、彼以外に惹かれないんです。
dialogue.English: But should I just stop? I've thought about looking for someone else, but I'm not attracted to anyone but him.

dialogue.content: そうですねでも辛いから、無理にでもやめた方がいいのか、できたら浮気をやめさせる方法を知りたいんですけど
dialogue.English: That's right... but since it’s so painful, I wonder if I should force myself to end it. Or, if it's possible, I’d like to know how to get him to stop cheating.

dialogue.content: 彼のことが大好きなんですね。
dialogue.English: You really love him, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 厳しい言葉かもしれませんが、人のことは変えられない。変えられるのは自分の行動だけ。と言われています。
dialogue.English: This may sound harsh, but it's often said that you can't change other people. You can only change your own actions.

dialogue.content: わたしが変われば浮気はやめるんでしょうか
dialogue.English: If I change, will he stop cheating?

dialogue.content: あなたが、今まで彼を許してきたことで、許してくれる人だと思われている可能性はあるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: It's possible that because you've forgiven him in the past, he may think you're someone who will always forgive him.

dialogue.content: 許した覚えはないんですけどじゃあ、別れた方がいいんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I don’t feel like I’ve ever forgiven him, though. So, does that mean I should break up with him?

dialogue.content: 今ここで急いで結論を出さなくともいいと思うのですが、そうですね、許したわけではないというと、どうしているのですか？
dialogue.English: I don’t think you need to rush to a conclusion right now. Since you feel you haven’t forgiven him, how do you handle things in those moments?

dialogue.content: 時間ですね💦
dialogue.English: Oh, it's time. 💦

dialogue.content: すみません！
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm sorry!

dialogue.content: すみません、意地悪なクライエントでしたかね💦💦お疲れ様でした！！
dialogue.English: I’m sorry—was I being a difficult client? 💦💦 Thank you for your time!!

dialogue.content: いいえ、勉強になりました！評価お待ちしています。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Not at all, this was a great learning experience! I look forward to your evaluation. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！！
dialogue.English: Thank you so much!!

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした。それでは、終了ボタンを押しますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. I’ll go ahead and press the end button now.
Okay (^^)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
